# Robo Presence: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-09 · code 0153cf68c95f · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Build a camera robot on wheels with a Raspberry Pi, an Arduino or an old phone, install it with one command, and drive it live from any browser over WebRTC.
**Live:** https://robo-presence.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/robo-presence · **Layout:** classic Anvil repo with a JavaScript front end (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `robo-presence/.claude/skills/robopresence/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- This folder **is** the Anvil repo. The front end is JavaScript in `theme/assets/`, started by the client form(s) below;
  the server is `server_code/`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code`; the JavaScript reaches it through the form's bridge (see *Client side*).
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert).
- **Check**: `python -I APP_MAKER/tools/gitapp_check.py <key>`; server tests: `python -I APP_MAKER/tools/gitapp_test.py`.
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push origin master` (pull first: Anvil commits too).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py robopresence` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Engines stay JavaScript** (theme/assets): rp-core.js (robot picture, lamps, gauges, copy/download), rp-sim.js
  (RobotCore + 3D garage), rp-link.js (WebRTC pilot link + RobotHost), rp-cockpit.js (driving screen; `RP.openCockpit`
  at the end takes plain JSON options), rp-builder.js (part cards, pin map, Arduino sketch; `RP.partsEditor` +
  `RP.moveToBoard` at the end are Forms-version additions), rp-bot.js (Web Serial Arduino + `RP.BotRunner`, the old
  bot page's start/stop). rp-kit.js = the old `window.UI` helpers the engines use; their server calls go through
  `window.RP_BRIDGE` and toasts/confirms through `RP.host` (client_code/rp.py `setup()`).
- **Protocol in three places** still: server_code/Parts.py, robot/robopresence/parts.py, rp-builder.js (+ cockpit).
  `rp.split` / `rp.pilot_gets` in client_code/rp.py are Python ports of RP.split / whatPilotGets (keep in step).
- Robot page = Pages/Robot (hero, tabs, 3 s robot_status poll via window.setInterval, cleared in `leave()`) + one Form
  per tab in client_code/Tabs; tabs call `page.set_robot(robot)` after an action. router.show() calls `leave()`.
- Pages/Drive has no layout (full-screen cockpit) and `waits = True`: Components/Cockpit sets UI_READY when connected.
- The validator types `self.x = None` as None for good: use `rp.loose(None)`. dom_nodes with built names go through
  a `_nodes()` helper.
- Anvil's template parser strips leading spaces inside `<pre>`: the landing/guide code blocks use `&nbsp;`.
- Tests: `python tools/check.py`; `python -I tools/ui_test.py` = tools/ui/smoke.js (every address, guest/member/admin,
  1280 + 390 px, incl. a guest pass). Real-robot and Web Serial paths can't run here (old bot_e2e.py lives in the
  retired source folder).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **events**: robot→robots, kind:str, text:str, at:dt, is_demo:bool · used in BotApi, DemoData, Robots
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **passes**: robot→robots, token_hash:str, label:str, role:str, expires:dt, created:dt, last_used:dt, uses:num, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Robots, Sharing
- **robots**: owner→users, name:str, color:str, notes:str, preset:str, config:obj, config_rev:num, manifest:obj, info:obj, telemetry:obj, last_seen:dt, wanted_until:dt, token_hash:str, tab_token_hash:str, install_code:str, install_code_expires:dt, paired_at:dt, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, BotApi, DemoData, Robots
- **sessions**: robot→robots, user→users, guest_pass→passes, pilot_name:str, role:str, secret_hash:str, offer:str, answer:str, state:str, created:dt, answered_at:dt, ended_at:dt, stats:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, BotApi, DemoData, Drive, Robots, Sharing
- **shares**: robot→robots, email:str, user→users, role:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Robots, Sharing
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData, Sharing

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
